scope: Audio recording in the desktop: arming, takes in the project's recordings folder, recorded clips with Undo/Redo and save/reopen, through preview and through the live PipeWire input stream on a private graph
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12, PipeWire 1.6.9), docker --network none, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, owned private PipeWire server at quantum 256, no devices or session manager
verified_behaviors: Arm exists only on audio tracks; arming a MIDI track is refused with the reason
Record is refused without an armed track or a saved project, and refuses a second Record, arming, track deletion, Open and New while recording; nothing is recorded on refusal
A 50-tick preview take is exactly 24,000 silent frames in recordings/TRACK take 1.wav, added and selected as a new clip in one Undo step
Undo removes the clip and keeps the file; Redo and save/reopen restore the clip
An immediate stop leaves no clip and deletes the empty file; the next take never reuses a name
Record and Stop through the production QML controls add a clip
Arming opens fl-live-input; a 1.5 s live take through Session::record() matches an independent stereo reference frame by frame and becomes the track's selected clip
limits: Audio only; MIDI recording, input monitoring and in-app input choice are not built (#43). No device-loss finalization (#46), timestamps (#45) or crash recovery (#48). Private software graph and offscreen QML only; no physical input, native Wayland or latency measurement.
